# Oviora Builder

Oviora Builder is a lightweight native Android Java/XML CLI builder for beginners and low-spec PCs.

Official website: https://oviora-builder.netlify.app/
NPM package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/oviora-builder
GitHub repository: https://github.com/nagodip7-sys/oviora-builder

## What it does

Oviora Builder creates real native Android Java/XML projects. It builds debug APKs with Gradle, installs them to a connected Android phone using ADB, and launches the app from the terminal.

## Best for

* Beginner Android developers
* Low-spec PCs
* Users who want native Android Java/XML without opening Android Studio
* Developers who do not want Cordova, Capacitor, Flutter, or React Native

## Install

npm install -g oviora-builder

## Quick start

oviora create MyApp
cd MyApp
oviora br

## Important positioning

Oviora Builder is not Cordova.
Oviora Builder is not a WebView app builder.
Oviora Builder is not Flutter.
Oviora Builder is not React Native.

Oviora Builder generates and manages native Android Java/XML projects using Java, XML, Android SDK, Gradle, and ADB.
